#!/bin/bash
# put this in a jenkins pipeline all with other no file rendering jobs.
mkdir -p ./biolincc/input/ mkdir -p ./biolincc/output/
for bucket_s3_name in ${bucket_s3_names}; do echo "Bucket: ${bucket_s3_name}" aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3 --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
# Function library is needed. aws s3api list-objects --bucket "${bucket_s3_name}" --query "Contents[?contains(Key, 'ensemble') && ends_with(Key, '.sas7bdat')].Key" --output text | \ while read -r key; do aws s3 cp "s3://${bucket_s3_name}/${key}" "./biolincc/input/$(basename "$key")" --no-progress done
aws s3api list-objects --bucket "${bucket_s3_name}" --query "Contents[?contains(Key, 'manifest') && ends_with(Key, '.tsv')].Key" --output text | \ while read -r key; do aws s3 cp "s3://${bucket_s3_name}/${key}" "./biolincc/input/$(basename "$key")" --no-progress done # aws s3 cp --recursive s3://${bucket_s3_name}/ ./_etl/input/ --exclude "*" --include "*ensemble*.sas7bdat*" --only-show-errors #aws s3 cp --recursive s3://${bucket_s3_name}/ ./_etl/input/ --exclude "*" --include "*manifest*.tsv*" --only-show-errors
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN done
